title: cremastus glutinosus var. angustifolius
intro: Cremastus glutinosus var. angustifolius, commonly known as Cremastobothrys, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asclepiadaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing fever and inflammation, as well as providing relief from respiratory issues. The health benefits of Cremastobothrys are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
